reason: 要旨は「In this paper, we propose \textbf{Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention} (MHA-CSP), a novel attention mechanism that replaces the standard dot-product with a \textbf{Mahalanobis distance-based RBF kernel}, which effectively computes attention in an infinite-dimensional feature space without increasing the parameter count.」を扱い、対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率・推論時圧縮への寄与を示していない。
title: Mahalanobis-Based Multi-Head Attention for Complex State Propagation
